sources.title: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct is a 3-billion-parameter open-weights instruction-tuned model developed by Meta, released September 2024. It supports text input/output with a 128K token context window and knowledge cutoff of December 2023. The model is available from multiple providers at competitive pricing starting from $0.030 per million input tokens.

sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct is a 3.21 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama and released September 25, 2024. This auto-regressive transformer uses Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for efficient inference and handles multilingual text input and output with a 128,000 token context window. sources.title: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Llama 3.2 is intended for commercial and research use in multiple languages. Instruction tuned text only models are intended for assistant-like chat and agentic applications like knowledge retrieval and summarization, mobile AI powered writing assistants and query and prompt rewriting. Pretrained models can be adapted for a variety of additional natural language generation tasks.
